chunks.title: Office blood pressure targets in adult hypertension
chunks.text: For most adults with hypertension, office blood pressure at or above 140/90 mmHg supports intensification of lifestyle measures and review of antihypertensive therapy such as an ACE inhibitor.

chunks.title: Lipid panel in cardiovascular risk review
chunks.text: An elevated LDL cholesterol finding should be interpreted with blood pressure and existing antihypertensive therapy when summarizing cardiovascular risk for clinician review.
